fnol_text: My name is Chloe Petrov and I live at 800 Hawthorn Way, Fairview, PA 16499. You can reach me on (555) 216-6734 or chloe.petrov@example.com. On 13 June 2023 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Kofi Varga, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00038. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Petrov on (555) 216-6734 to acknowledge the claim. Chloe confirmed the loss date as 13 June 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Chloe Brennan gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Kofi Varga reports a sprained ankle and attended Mercy General. Chloe reports a mild concussion.
